create_DemoEval: create a DemoEval instance for thresholded COCO-style segmentation or bbox evaluation with a configurable IoU threshold
run_DemoEval_evaluateImg: run evaluateImg on a DemoEval to compute per-image TP/FP/FN, precision, recall, F1, and image-level metrics
summarize_DemoEval: summarize DemoEval results by accumulating per-image metrics and printing CGF1, precision, recall, F1, J, F, J&F scores
build_DemoEvaluator: build a DemoEvaluator wrapping multiple COCO ground truths and predictions for bbox and segmentation demo evaluation
test_DemoEvaluator_select_best_scoring: test select_best_scoring on DemoEvaluator to pick the best oracle scoring across multiple ground truth matches per image
